cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-library-snapshot-survives-restart
cases.purpose: Restore populated and empty sidebar snapshots without network calls; keep file private and reject another account.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-snapshot-failure-is-a-cache-miss
cases.purpose: Corrupt, oversized and incompatible snapshots fail open without evaluating their contents.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-library-loads-are-deduplicated-and-isolated
cases.purpose: Rapid navigation shares per-key requests; offline and disposed callbacks preserve visible cached data.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-background-diff-preserves-identities
cases.purpose: An unchanged background reply leaves the GUI publication revision unchanged; changed replies and revisits preserve selected song and scroll anchor.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-new-session-is-headless
cases.purpose: A session built without a buffer starts on the daily library, shows the lyric panel and sends no request.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-refresh-loads-library-and-playback
cases.purpose: Refreshing loads the library rows, the account name, the playback truth with queue position and the visible page.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-refresh-keeps-selection-inside-the-page
cases.purpose: Switching libraries replaces the rows, resets the selection and the page, and keeps each row's kind.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-locate-rejects-unknown-library
cases.purpose: An unknown library raises the package error and leaves the current library untouched.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-sections-inventory-is-navigable
cases.purpose: Every section published in the sidebar inventory can be opened and titles itself.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-search-records-keyword-and-scope
cases.purpose: Searching trims the keyword, shows the results, sends the scope, and rejects a blank keyword.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-play-uses-the-selected-row
cases.purpose: Playing a song selection queues its current library, jumps to the selected full-list index, and reports the song it started.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-play-accepts-rows-ids-and-keywords
cases.purpose: Song rows in a playable library preserve the library queue; bare ids, keywords and playlist rows retain their direct play targets.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-add-to-queue-takes-songs-only
cases.purpose: Queueing appends a song row to the backend queue and rejects a playlist row.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-transport-commands-reach-the-backend
cases.purpose: Transport, volume, seek, shuffle, list repeat, like and queue-jump commands send their existing requests; repeat reports 列表循环 on and off.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-liked-table-decides-the-heart
cases.purpose: The playing song's heart follows the liked-song id table, and liking a song keeps the session table in step.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-like-button-toggles-the-heart
cases.purpose: A press on a liked heart sends an unlike and turns it hollow; a second press sends a like again.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-toggle-starts-the-selected-song-when-nothing-is-loaded
cases.purpose: SPC with an empty queue plays the selected row instead of toggling a queue that has nothing to toggle.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-press-on-the-selected-row-plays-it
cases.purpose: Pressing the selected song row plays its library and jumps to the row without a timing window.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-press-selects-another-row-before-playing
cases.purpose: Pressing another row selects it; pressing it again plays its library then jumps to its loaded position.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-transport-effect-is-visible-before-the-reply
cases.purpose: Pausing flips the displayed playback state before the backend answers, so a transport command shows its effect immediately.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-locate-shows-cached-rows-before-the-refresh
cases.purpose: Revisiting a library shows its cached rows at once, refreshes in the background, and keeps the reader's selection.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-selection-keeps-its-page
cases.purpose: Selection clamps at both ends, scrolls the page to stay visible, and an empty library plays nothing.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-toggle-aside-switches-panels
cases.purpose: The side panel alternates between the lyric and the queue.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-show-pane-selects-the-visible-pane
cases.purpose: Showing a pane records it in the snapshot and an unknown pane signals while keeping the previous pane.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-queue-and-lyric-follow-playback
cases.purpose: The snapshot reports the queue around the playing entry and the lyric line of the elapsed position.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-parse-lyric-reads-lrc
cases.purpose: LRC parsing keeps tagged lines in time order, splits repeated timestamps and ignores metadata and untagged lines.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-backend-failure-is-reported-not-signaled
cases.purpose: A failing backend reply lands in the session error and message while the player stays usable.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-missing-backend-is-reported-not-signaled
cases.purpose: A backend whose scripts are missing lands in the session error and message instead of signaling.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-skill-refusal-reports-its-own-message
cases.purpose: A refused skill command surfaces the backend's own stderr report (shell text lines or the mpv bridge's JSON) instead of the bare exit status; a crash without a report keeps the exit status.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-client-call-reaches-a-function-client
cases.purpose: The documented client protocol drives a plain function client and cancels without error.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-theme-tokens-cover-both-palettes
cases.purpose: Colours resolve per palette, an unknown colour raises the package error, and the UI tokens follow the mode.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-mount-renders-and-revives
cases.purpose: Mounting paints the library into a buffer, and killing that buffer lets the same session mount again.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-open-and-close-own-a-buffer
cases.purpose: Opening installs the player keymap, routes active wheel bindings above the renderer, hides the mode line, and closing kills the buffer.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-open-fills-the-selected-window
cases.purpose: Opening the player replaces the selected window instead of splitting the frame into a second pane.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-default-client-runs-the-skill-command
cases.purpose: The default client runs the skill script with the request translated into the right command line: a play request reaches the script as "play <song id>".

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-browse-limit-covers-long-libraries
cases.purpose: Browse loads beyond 100 rows, preserves the backend total, and takes the maximum of list-limit, fetch-limit and three pages.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-library-total-survives-cache-and-refresh
cases.purpose: A partial library displays loaded and true totals, preserves them through cache hits, updates totals even with identical rows, reports zero loaded rows honestly, and preserves cached counts after a failed refresh.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-long-library-keys-show-one-based-ranges
cases.purpose: Home, End, PageUp and PageDown navigate all 500 loaded rows and the footer shows one-based ranges with the true total.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-song-row-starts-in-one-command
cases.purpose: Daily, liked and FM presses capture the loaded ids and starting index in one request; later selection changes cannot alter it.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-song-row-failure-and-supersession
cases.purpose: Failed, superseded and late playback replies never issue a follow-up jump over another playback command.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-other-libraries-play-rows-directly
cases.purpose: Recent, search, playlist, album, artist, chart and podcast rows keep their individual play targets without a library jump.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-sidebar-entry-click-switches-library
cases.purpose: Sidebar labels and their blank cell rows switch libraries through mouse activation, and TAB/RET retains keyboard activation.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-sidebar-selection-highlights-one-line
cases.purpose: A selected sidebar library paints one text line, not its whole two-line click cell.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-sidebar-group-labels-leave-a-gap
cases.purpose: A sidebar group label keeps a blank line between itself and its first entry.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-viewport-width-uses-pixels
cases.purpose: The initial canvas uses ETAF's display-safe pixel viewport and a subsequent window refit preserves that same width without discovering a different canvas.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-play-all-only-for-supported-origins
cases.purpose: Wide and compact headers render 播放全部 only for daily, liked and FM origins.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-queue-wheel-scrolls-only-the-event-panel
cases.purpose: Active wheel bindings in all layouts reach every loaded queue entry, use the event window, leave the library selection and window alone outside the queue, display backend count, retain manual scrolling across unchanged polls, and recenter on track advance.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-library-wheel-scrolls-the-window-without-selection
cases.purpose: Wheel over the library scrolls the row window one row per tick without moving the selection, clamps at both ends, keeps the page range true, and keyboard selection still brings the row back into view.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-panel-budgets-fit-resized-windows
cases.purpose: Queue and lyric budgets shrink with the displayed window; translated lyrics fit their budget and retain the current line.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-superseded-library-keeps-visible-total
cases.purpose: A new uncached library clears old rows and totals; a late foreground reply cannot overwrite a revisited cached library.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-queue-entries-click-and-tab-activate
cases.purpose: Queue entries reached by wheel still jump through mouse activation and TAB/RET without changing library selection.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-player-volume-drag-and-reply
cases.purpose: Volume gestures publish the pointer value, show the new range immediately, reconcile the backend reply, clamp endpoints and ignore cancellation.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-stale-status-keeps-the-pointed-volume
cases.purpose: A status reply older than the volume command keeps the pointed volume instead of snapping the percentage back.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-stale-status-keeps-the-pointed-position
cases.purpose: A status reply older than a seek keeps the clicked position instead of snapping the progress bar back.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-player-progress-range-seeks-by-pointer
cases.purpose: The progress range tracks the reported position and a seek gesture uses the pointed fraction.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-player-quality-and-compact-layouts
cases.purpose: Only backend quality is badged; medium and narrow bars drop the cover and badge while retaining play, progress and volume controls.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-player-pane-buttons-preserve-state
cases.purpose: Cover, lyric and queue controls reveal their panes across layouts while preserving the library selection.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-player-clock-moves-the-elapsed-label-and-meter
cases.purpose: Playing seconds move the retained elapsed label and widen the shared range fill that carries the progress meter.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-keys-reach-the-player-around-the-renderer-map
cases.purpose: The documented transport and page keys reach the player through the real command loop even though the renderer's minor-mode map binds the same keys, and RET falls back to the selected row.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-refresh-pauses-while-hidden
cases.purpose: A player whose buffer no window shows pauses background library refreshes, and showing it again resumes them.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-library-failure-pauses-refresh
cases.purpose: A background library refresh failing with an auth error pauses the warmer until a foreground load succeeds.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-refresh-marks-downloaded-rows
cases.purpose: Refreshing asks the backend for the local download registry and folds it into the library rows.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-download-requests-the-row-and-marks-it
cases.purpose: Downloading a row sends the song id, shows the pending message, then marks the row and records the file from the reply.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-download-refreshes-an-existing-file
cases.purpose: A second download of a song that is already local asks the backend to refresh the file in place.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-row-action-dispatches-by-key
cases.purpose: The row-menu action resolves the row when chosen and dispatches play, queue or download by key, rejecting bad input.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-download-key-uses-the-selection
cases.purpose: The d key downloads the row the library selection points at through the mounted player.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-download-reply-survives-a-track-switch
cases.purpose: A download reply that lands after the reader switched songs still registers the file by song id, marks the row and reports completion.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-lyric-cache-serves-a-restart
cases.purpose: The first session stores a lyric in the SQLite media cache beside the snapshot and a fresh session publishes the same lines without asking the backend.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-child-environment-always-has-a-utf8-locale
cases.purpose: The backend child environment always carries a UTF-8 locale, overriding a missing or non-UTF-8 parent locale.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-only-the-playing-row-shows-the-play-marker
cases.purpose: Only the playing row shows the play marker while every other row keeps its number, covering both the computed-source read and the per-slot closure.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-cover-request-downloads-through-the-skill-entry
cases.purpose: The cover request downloads the song's art to the caller's file through the skill entry.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-queue-tracks-keep-the-cover-url
cases.purpose: Normalized queue tracks keep the backend cover URL and default it to an empty string.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-mounted-player-publishes-the-cover-art
cases.purpose: Downloaded cover art is published as image content in the mounted player.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-playing-song-cover-is-downloaded-to-the-state-directory
cases.purpose: Refreshing downloads the playing song's cover into the local cache exactly once.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-cover-clears-when-the-playing-song-has-none
cases.purpose: Moving to a song without a cover clears the previous art immediately without retrying.

cases.name: etaf-ncm-tests-cover-index-serves-the-next-session
cases.purpose: A downloaded cover is indexed with its URL, a changed URL misses, and a fresh session reuses the indexed file without downloading again.
